narrative: Four levers explain most of Aktia's earnings risk: 12-month Euribor (about €8M of 2027 NII per 50 bp down, €6M per 25 bp up as hedges roll), AUM (about €0.7M of fees per point), cost of risk (about €0.8M per bp on a €7.9bn book) and the cost-to-income ratio (about €2.9M of cost per point). The same drivers feed NII, commissions, credit losses, CIR, ROE and CET1.

signals.title: Path to CIR < 60%: +€11.3M income, −€6.5M cost
signals.excerpt: AUM +5%, Euribor +25 bp as hedges roll, MOPS price list +3%, Oracle decommission, purchased services, 15 open positions → CIR 58.7%, ROE 14.9% (13.3% with normal credit losses).
